# `Browser.Speech`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Speech — one-shot speech synthesis and queue control via the
browser `speechSynthesis` API, over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` (`speak` / `cancel`) triggers the browser
synthesiser, and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the outcome — a completion or a
typed error. Both cross the same seal codec and fail-closed port discipline as
every other port; there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses `js-port:speech`
(import-derived, keyed on the canonical `Ipe.Browser.Speech` path prefix via
`WebCapability::for_browser_module`, alias-immune); only the top-level app's
`[capabilities] accepts` set can grant it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Speech.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs,
    the `Options` record, and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js` wiring.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `speak` returns a `Task Error ()` via
    the correlated port→Task bridge; `cancel` is fire-and-forget `Cmd`-shaped;
    `outcomes` is the inbound subscription. The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE:
    every variant becomes either an `Ok` or a typed `Err`, never a silently
    dropped frame.

## `Options`

Synthesis options — see `Ipe.Browser.Speech.Internals.Options` for field
semantics. Re-exported here so callers only need this module.

## `defaultOptions`

```ipe
defaultOptions : Options
```

Sensible defaults: normal rate, pitch, and volume; browser-default language.

## `speak`

```ipe
speak : String -> Options -> Task Error ()
```

`speak text opts` — synthesise `text` with the given options, as a
`Task Error ()`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). The served JS handler
calls `speechSynthesis.cancel()` (to clear any queued utterance), constructs
a `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`, applies `opts`, and calls
`speechSynthesis.speak()`. The `Task` resolves with `()` on the `onend`
event and with a typed `Err` on `onerror` or when `speechSynthesis` is
absent. No eval, no innerHTML.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:speech`; the app must grant it with
`accepts = [ JsPort Speech ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `cancel`

```ipe
cancel : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`cancel` — cancel any queued or in-progress utterance, fire-and-forget.

Calls `speechSynthesis.cancel()` on the JS side. No inbound reply arrives;
any in-flight `speak` task will resolve once the browser fires its `onerror`
event for the interrupted utterance.

## `outcomes`

```ipe
outcomes : (Result Error () -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`outcomes toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a `Result Error ()`.
